en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Ibrahim Bin Umar Al Yamani, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There is none from a man in whose house two Momins enter, so he feeds them and satiates them, except that, it would be superior than freeing a person’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Ibrahim ibn ‘Umar al-Yamani from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
The serving of a man’s food at his home to two of the believing people to their satisfaction is more meritorious than the setting free of a human soul.”
